schedules.description: An open surface receives two pending statuses before the third check becomes ready.
The foreground dialog closes while its first status request is in flight and that request later reports pending.
The foreground dialog closes while its first status request is in flight and that request later reports ready.
The dialog closes, reopens for another token, then the old ready response arrives before the current response.

counterfactual_pairs.changed_relation: close moves from absent to before a pending response.
the same late status changes from pending to ready after close.
a new dialog generation begins before the old ready response arrives.
